TianGong does contain a semantically exact flow, 'Microorganism' (725a2539-3594-448f-b0be-9c80402c594f, kg), with one producer: 'Soil Remediation; Bioreactor; Microbial Cultures; Microorganisms Cultured in the Laboratory' (eeaf8532-887c-4bc6-b689-8b47cece06c5, IT 2018, D'Imporzano et al. 2019). addons.note: Combustion CO2 of diesel burned on site: 74,100 kg CO2/TJ x 43.0 MJ/kg x 0.84 kg/L = 2.68 kg/L. Upstream diesel production stays a cut-off; NOx, PM, CH4 and N2O of the engines are not added.
addons.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol. 2, Table 1.4 (gas/diesel oil default emission factor); EN 590 density 0.82-0.845 kg/L
